name: Goblet March
instructions: Hold a kettlebell or dumbbell at your chest in the goblet position.
Stand tall and march in place, driving each knee to hip height.
Brace the core and keep the torso vertical — don't lean back.
Continue for time or steps. Builds hip flexor strength and marching coordination.
longevityNotes: A stable trunk protects the spine through every decade. Train the core for endurance and control rather than chasing burn.
overview: A beginner a kettlebell core exercise for the quadriceps. Goblet March builds the trunk stability that underpins safe movement as you age.
